dialect.detail: IBM mainframe-style COBOL with RECORDING MODE F, COMP-3, RETURN-CODE special register, and indexed file handling; Turkish-language comments suggest educational context possibly on IBM z/OS or compatible environment

purpose.domain_detail: Currency account balance processing with TRY/USD/EUR currency codes (949=TRY, 840=USD, 978=EUR ISO codes) and customer account records
purpose.summary: Reads an input file of ID/division-code pairs, looks up each record in an indexed file, converts Julian dates to Gregorian, applies a currency-specific balance adjustment based on ISO currency codes, and writes formatted output records. Turkish comments explain each paragraph.

notable_features: INDEXED file with RANDOM access and composite key (IDX-KEY)
COMP-3 packed decimal fields for ID, DATE, BALLANCE
RECORDING MODE F on sequential files
FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DAY / DATE-OF-INTEGER for date conversion
88-level condition names for file status codes
ISO 4217 currency codes used as numeric division codes (949 TRY, 840 USD, 978 EUR)
verdict.notes: All comments are in Turkish, suggesting this is a student or training exercise by author Yasar Okten. The program logic is straightforward and educational in nature. The HEADER 01-level under OUT-FILE FD appears to be defined but unused. Minor structural oddity: 03-level PROGRAM-ST under 01 WS-WORK-AREA (should be 05 level) suggests a student error.
